successors.text: the Mycenaean state of Pylos, 'covered an area of 2,000 km2' (a 25 km disc round Pylos, 1,963 km2)

ledger.x: c. 1600: the Mycenaean state of Pylos. 'The Mycenaean state of Pylos (1600-1200 BC) covered an area of 2,000 km2' and 'became the capital of one of the most important human centers of this civilization and of a powerful kingdom'. The page gives no rise date apart from the range; the Palace of Nestor page dates the…

c. 1180: fire destroys the palace of Pylos. 'It was destroyed by fire around 1180 BC'; the Linear B tablets 'mention hasty defence preparations due to an imminent attack without giving any detail about the attacking force'. The page also ends the state at 1200 and the Palace of Nestor page dates the fire 'around 1250…

certainty.note: No boundary is known; the area (2,000 km2) is the page's, the shape is a disc.
